0.heading: Overview
refs: Acts 3:1 , Peter preaching to the people that came to see a lame man restored to his feet
Acts 3:12 . professes the cure not to have been wrought by his or John's own power or holiness, but by God, and his son Jesus, and through faith in his name
Acts 3:13 , withal reprehending them for crucifying Jesus
Acts 3:17 , which because they did it through ignorance, and that thereby were fulfilled God's determinate counsel, and the Scriptures
Acts 3:19 . he exhorts them by repentance and faith to seek remission of their sins, and salvation in the same Jesus.
